script.structure_block:
video TAI LIEU ANH THAT ngoi thu 3 ke tieu su/so phan MOT NGUOI trong mot tran danh/su kien WW2 Nhat Ban (narrator nhu dang thuyet minh truoc anh tu lieu trong bao tang - mo ta CHI TIET nhung gi thay trong anh truoc khi ke boi canh). KHONG chia chuong co marker (khac Lane A) - mach ke LIEN TUC theo 3 khoi:
   - Dao dau (~10% chu): gioi thieu nhan vat qua MOT buc anh cu the (mo ta anh truoc, roi ten/tuoi/chuc vu/thoi diem), goi so phan sap xay ra ma chua noi ro - mo vong lap.
   - Than bai (~70% chu): dien bien theo THOI GIAN THAT (ngay thang cu the lay tu series_ctx.txt), moi doan gan voi 1 anh/1 moc - quyet dinh, hanh dong, boi canh tran danh, doi thoai/thu tu neu co nguon. Mat do neo so lieu deu theo gate.fact_anchor_per_min, hedge cho chi tiet chua chac chan theo gate.hedge_min_per_10min - KHONG bia chi tiet ngoai series_ctx.txt.
   - Ket (~20% chu): ket cuc cua nhan vat + DAU VET CON LAI toi ngay nay (di vat/tam bia/hoi uc gia dinh/anh luu tru) - khong phan xet chinh tri, giu giong ton trong, ket bang 1 cau suy ngam mo cho nguoi xem.
   Ti le UOC LUONG theo cau truc tieu su pho quat (khong do duoc ranh gioi ro nhu A vi lane nay khong co chapter marker - 11 tap da san xuat chi co doan van tu do 11-24 doan/tap). Day la goi y PROMPT viet, KHONG phai nguong gate hau kiem (lean chi gate TONG chu).

body.assemble_note: BAT BUOC dung --anchors (khong dung sync_durations mac dinh): sync_durations() chia DEU anh theo tong thoi luong audio, mu ve anh nao ung voi doan van nao -> do that EP1 la 4/8 moc lech hinh/loi (B8Q sync_score 2.9/5). Phai tao file anchors.txt (dong 'ten_anh.png|cau neo nguyen van trong script.txt', neo la 1 cau/cum tu XUAT HIEN DUNG 1 LAN trong script) roi chay assemble.py --anchors anchors.txt --srt <srt da gion nhip>. anchor_durations() tra vi tri neo trong SRT da noi de lay dung mocs thoi gian theo CAU VAN, khong phai theo so dem. Da fix EP1 tu 2.9 len 3.8/5, 0 diem yeu. Anh mo dau/ket phai co 1 anh neo vao cau ket (bookend) neu script co cau quay lai nhac anh dau.

Cover-crop cu (khong --fit-height) ep khung ngang 1280x720 len anh doc thi KHONG CON BIEN NGANG de day mat sang mot ben -> mat luon ket GIUA khung du --side la gi, dung dung vao vung chu (da dinh that ep02-05, anh nguoi dung phai ve lai). --fit-height scale theo CHIEU CAO (giu tron kho doc, khong cat dau/vai), ghim ca khoi mat ve --subject-side right, phan trong ben trai lap bang chinh anh do phong to lam nen mo cho chu dung rieng. CHI dung cover-crop cu (bo --fit-height) cho anh NHOM/CANH RONG kieu ep01 (nhieu nguoi dan trai chieu ngang) — anh do fit-height se ghim mat theo goc, cat mat nguoi khac.
